remaining_inventory.caveat: Remaining outside identified CRT/imports includes application functions, unresolved support, shared data and padding; no claim all bytes are reachable application instructions. Accepted source count and extent do not establish branch completion.

final_live_build.scope: Explicit final link compiles sharedCdirectly with frozen current sources/headers; source snapshots taken immediately before/after. Existing object files retain the unchanged accepted target sources. Earlier cached finalnative make receipt is retained separately; this receipt establishes actual shared compilation at final link, not merely a present-tree fingerprint.
